imports.modification_summary: Python to TypeScript, line for line in algorithm: atomic blocks (headers, code fences, table header plus separator, table rows, list items with continuations, paragraphs, blanks), greedy assembly with header-preferred splits that keep at least half a chunk, overlap lines and table-header carry across every continuation, start offset. Offsets count UTF-16 code units. Names in Aladdin style. Header-preferred splits use running prefix sizes (the donor sums inside its backward scan, which is quadratic in a chunk's blocks).

imports.modification_summary: SPA state blob removal (JSON in inline code, $type objects, nested objects, long lines that parse as JSON). The donor's lazy regexes are replaced by linear scans, with blobs bounded to 64 KiB; blank lines between blocks are kept (one at most) instead of all removed; Markdown hard breaks are kept. Adds Aladdin's text safety rule (well formed, no controls, no invisible format characters).

imports.modification_summary: Keeps the donor's rules: non-content elements are skipped, hidden inline-JSON code (its id patterns) and inline data: images are dropped, a header row (thead, or a first row of th) leads the table. The donor serialises to HTML and converts with the Python markdownify package; Aladdin converts its own content model straight to Markdown with the conventions the donor configures (ATX headings, '-' bullets, no escaping, no autolinks). No markdownify code is copied and no dependency is added. Links and images are opt-in and limited to resolved http(s) URLs; nesting past 100 levels is flattened iteratively; output is bounded in size and time.
